trigger: Independent review found that a caller-labeled PASS report, an unreadable input, or an incomplete scan scope could satisfy release preflight.

whys.answer: Preflight trusted report status and subject labels without binding them to the candidate files and scanner configuration.
whys.evidence: Independent review of the public identity report contract

whys.answer: The first digest covered only successfully read allowlisted files, excluding observations, registry state, overrides, private-pattern configuration, and other scoped files.
File discovery was designed for convenient text scanning rather than complete release-evidence provenance.
Tests generated synthetic PASS objects instead of proving the scanner-to-preflight evidence chain.

stop_reason: Evidence does not establish that a public release or submission relied on the incomplete report contract.
immediate_correction: Block missing, empty, or unreadable text inputs and require current, internally consistent release reports.
root_cause_correction: Bind release evidence to the canonical subject, exact declared text paths, registry, observations, private-pattern hashes, overrides, roots, and every scoped file byte.
recurrence_guard: End-to-end scanner and Apple preflight tests reject stale, unrelated, omitted, unreadable, empty, configuration-changed, and digest-mismatched evidence.
